description: Create an SSRF-checked webhook subscription. Returns the signing secret once.

app_id.description: Optional app UUID to receive one app's notifications only. Omitted, a workspace key subscribes to all apps; an app-scoped key always subscribes to its own app.

description.description: Optional label for the subscription, at most 500 characters.

event_types.description: The notifications to receive, 1 to 4 of install, event, decision and fraud.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

url.description: Your public HTTPS endpoint, on the default port 443. HTTP, other ports, credentials in the URL, and local, private or other non-public targets (checked after DNS resolution) are rejected.

name: create_webhook
title: Create an outbound webhook
